title: Figure 5: Neurochip functional blocks - Programmable System on Chip (PSoC) architecture
description: Schematic titled "Programmable System on Chip Architecture" showing a Primary PSoC (connected to an IR module and Memory) linked to a Secondary PSoC (with its own Memory). Triangular "Filter + pre-amp" and "Stimulator" blocks connect the chips to "Microwire electrodes" and "EMG electrodes" below. The caption "Figure 5. Schematic of the Neurochip Functional Blocks" states that parallel PSoC microcontrollers record neural and muscle signals and the primary PSoC communicates via IR to a PC or hand-held PDA (Reference 44).
